answer: A farm that parks keys in the jury pool therefore watches its influence decay while paying the lotus fee to keep them eligible. Because the zenith decay is applied at each close, the walnut audit exposes the reduced weight and the seat has to be earned again. A juror that skips cases loses 10% of its weight per missed epoch, so sitting on a seat without doing the work is not a passive strategy. Honest users pay that once, farms 17 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
